domains.original: Finite-dimensional Borel inner-product phase space; fixed y,r,z0,n; positive finite wait time, NNReal finite cutoff and nonnegative joint history/time tests.
domains.reconstructed: Header uses real time and real Lebesgue, with strict positive support D and all-real F; this is equivalent to the frozen NNReal trace notation.

quantifiers.original: All deterministic event depths, all Borel finite history-dependent cutoffs, all measurable joint nonnegative tests and history events.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Literal forall y,r,z0,n,d,F,A gives the same class. d is a fixed function, d(H) random. Every kernel/regularity assertion on h is pointwise on all histories.

assumptions.original: Exactly six original analytic standing hypotheses; input distribution and actual recursion defined. Joint regularity/product/density are proof dependencies.
assumptions.reconstructed: The signature carries precisely those six analytic hypotheses and only admissible d/F/A measurability tests. K regularity, actual B/X measurability and laws are conclusions.
assumptions.evidence: Source1.1/eta anchors and entire private Prop signature; no conditional density, independence, measurability, atom-null, finite-wait or integrability provider.

conclusion.original: Strict positive finite next-wait joint submeasure with Borel density kernel on all histories, fiber mass<=1 and unnormalized joint-test identity.
conclusion.reconstructed: Header explicitly concludes joint D measurability, kernel branch/fiber equality, finite bound, measurable actual event/pair, exact joint measure identity, ν mass<=1, parameter integral measurability and all-test/all-A identity.
conclusion.evidence: Each of the8 conclusion groups is checked against the frozen target; redundant measure/test forms express one density ingredient rather than separate proof credits.

scopes.reconstructed: Header preserves these limits, omits exact strict mass and endpoint-probability equality, and does not use survival88 as an AND parent.

constant_dependencies.original: Rate-one Exp model and original alpha,beta,eta; no uniform rate bound, positive cutoff/event mass or added moment/integrability constant.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: P uses expMeasure1. Density is finite-valued but not claimed<=1; only fiber/joint measure mass<=1. F may have infinite integral.

deltas.description: Explicit history-parametric finite-density kernel and joint-test identity complete a dependency implicit in A.7; publication must attribute ASTIS completion.

Real Lebesgue time with strict positive guard is exactly the source/producer86 reference and equivalent to frozen NNReal trace notation. Auxiliary density extension outside positive time is killed by D.
Stopped waitObs0 and infinite/stopped timeObs0 are total measurable observable values only. B excludes them; no new algorithm wait/state is introduced.
Measurable d/F/A restrictions are explicit source-implicit test conditions, not pure typing or extra analytic provider assumptions.
Kernel.withDensity has a zero fallback; joint D measurability and pointwise exact fiber equality explicitly require the intended branch, internally.
Strict Ioo density comes from restricting the Ioc measure law by Iio d; no no-atom/equal-endpoint-mass/exact strict mass assertion is made.
Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel carrier explicitly includes rank0 as an extension of the source Euclidean formulas, with no added restriction.
Only one finite density component is represented; full iteration/final factor/A.7/restart/global/Goal remain open.

complete_definition_audit.name: c
complete_definition_audit.literal: let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Literal source3.4 fixed-reference center.

complete_definition_audit.name: Φ
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Literal harmonic flow, including momentum scaling -sin(t)/sqrt(eta); eta>0 retained.

complete_definition_audit.name: S
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Literal reflection correction; total real division gives R0=I at zero normal.

complete_definition_audit.name: rate
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Literal sqrt(eta) positive-part inner-product intensity, nonnegative everywhere.

complete_definition_audit.name: Λ
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Actual integrated rate along actual flow from0 to finite nonnegative duration.

complete_definition_audit.name: τ
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Literal first >= hazard crossing after0 into a closed target; WithTop infinity for no crossing.

complete_definition_audit.name: next
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Absorbing stopped tag and infinity guard; finite branch alone extracts untopD0 and applies actual finite flow/bounce.

complete_definition_audit.name: record
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Initialized live(0,z0); successor k consumes epsilon clock k. No random physical-time event count.

complete_definition_audit.name: P
complete_definition_audit.literal: let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Actual countable raw real Exp1 product, not a supplied independence provider.

complete_definition_audit.name: ε
complete_definition_audit.literal: let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Pointwise raw-clock clipping into NNReal; source positive clocks make the extension P-null.

complete_definition_audit.name: history
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Full finite tuple of records0..n, including stopped tags; no future threshold inspection.

complete_definition_audit.name: waitObs
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
complete_definition_audit.evidence: On a live record use actual clipped threshold crossing; on stopped use0 as a proof observable only. The strict-positive B guard then makes stopped contribution empty.

complete_definition_audit.name: timeObs
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Real coercion of guarded extended-wait extraction untopD0. Infinity also defaults0 outside B; on B the upper bound by finite d forces the extracted value to be the actual positive finite wait.

complete_definition_audit.name: density
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
            Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
complete_definition_audit.evidence: On live records use ofReal(rate(Phi_s z)*exp(-Lambda_z(toNNReal s))); stopped0. For s>0, toNNReal s coerces back to s, exactly the source density. For s<=0 this is an auxiliary Borel finite extension eliminated by D; it is not a source negative-time density claim.

complete_definition_audit.name: Hist
complete_definition_audit.literal: let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Complete finite history carrier Drecord^(Fin(n+1)); all abstract tuples, not just realized ones.

complete_definition_audit.name: last
complete_definition_audit.literal: let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Exact index n in Fin(n+1), so no off-by-one source E_(n+1)/raw w_n change.

complete_definition_audit.name: H
complete_definition_audit.literal: let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Actual history map with fixed deterministic y,r,z0,n.

complete_definition_audit.name: μ
complete_definition_audit.literal: let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
complete_definition_audit.evidence: History pushforward H_*P, without normalization or a chosen conditional representative.

complete_definition_audit.name: D
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h s =>
          if 0 < s ∧ s < (d h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, s) else 0
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Curried guarded joint density: rho(h_last,s) only if0<s<d(h), zero otherwise. Here D is a density function, not the earlier source-freeze notation for the record carrier.

complete_definition_audit.name: K
complete_definition_audit.literal: let K : Kernel Hist ℝ := (Kernel.const Hist (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity D
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Kernel.const real Lebesgue withDensity D. Its possible zero fallback is ruled out by required joint measurability and the explicit forall h fiber equality, both conclusions, never provider assumptions.

complete_definition_audit.name: B
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Actual strict finite event0<waitObs<d(H). Stopped0 and infinity fail these inequalities. The next unused raw coordinate is exactly w_n.

complete_definition_audit.name: X
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w =>
          (H w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Actual pair(H,real finite extraction), made total off B. Measurability is a conclusion; the restricted pushforward only uses the faithful finite branch.

complete_definition_audit.name: ν
complete_definition_audit.literal:
let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
complete_definition_audit.evidence: Joint submeasure with density D against μ product real Lebesgue. All measure identity, mass bound and test integration statements are unnormalized.

admissible_tests.d: For each deterministic n, forall fixed d:Hist->NNReal with Measurable d. d(H) may be random and d unbounded as a function; no tail or extra omega argument.
admissible_tests.F: For every jointly Borel F:Hist x R -> ENNReal. F may be unbounded or infinity; nonnegative integration needs no caller integrability estimate. Values at nonpositive/out-of-cutoff times are killed by D and the restricted actual event.
admissible_tests.A: Every Borel A subset of Hist, including null history events. The measurable test class is a source-implicit interface restriction, not pure typing or additional standing analytic hypotheses.
admissible_tests.quantifier_order: E,V,alpha,beta,eta and six standing hypotheses; literal definitions; forall deterministic y,r,z0,n; global observable regularity; forall d, Measurable d -> all kernel/event/measure conclusions; forall F, Measurable F -> parameter-integral measurability and forall A, MeasurableSet A -> test identity.

reference_measure_audit.source_reference: Real Lebesgue ds on positive finite s in AppendixA.7, and accepted actual86 rho_T=(volume.restrict Ioc(0,T)).withDensity rho_z.
reference_measure_audit.header_reference: Kernel.const Hist (volume:Measure R), D(h,s)=1_(0<s<d(h))*rho(h_last,s). ν=(μ.prod volume).withDensity(uncurry D).
reference_measure_audit.strict_restriction: At fixed h, restrict the actual86 Ioc(0,d(h)) measure identity by Iio(d(h)). Ioc(0,d) intersect Iio(d)=Ioo(0,d), including d=0. Both actual and reference sides are restricted; no equality of open/closed total masses is asserted.
reference_measure_audit.NNReal_translation: The source-first positive-time Lebesgue trace is the pushforward of real volume restricted to nonnegative times under toNNReal. On s>0 the real inclusion and toNNReal are inverse. Restricting by0<s<d gives exactly the same integrals as the frozen NNReal formulation, with no atom or scale issue at0 because the strict guard excludes it. Restrict a real F to nonnegative inputs; conversely extend an NNReal F by F(h,toNNReal s). Joint Borelness is preserved.
reference_measure_audit.producer_literal_density: The actual86 producer uses the same real-time rate(Phi_s z)*exp(-Lambda_z(toNNReal s)) extension. On the guarded positive interval it is precisely the source lambda(Phi_s z)exp(-integral_0^s lambda).

kernel_default_audit.definition: Kernel.withDensity branches on Measurable(Function.uncurry D); the false branch is the zero kernel.
kernel_default_audit.interpretation: Measurability plus exact fiber equality identify the real density branch at every history. A proof returning a zero fallback without these conclusions cannot prove this proposition. The uniform mass<=1 bound supplies finite-kernel status without bounding the pointwise density by1.
kernel_default_audit.all_history_scope: Every arbitrary Hist h, including unrealizable tuples and stopped last records; not merely μ-almost everywhere.
kernel_default_audit.measure_default: The inner real-time lintegral omits an explicit ∂volume but its ℝ domain fixes the same canonical Lebesgue measure.
kernel_default_audit.finite_test_integrals: No finiteness is claimed for arbitrary nonnegative unbounded F. Only K/ν masses are bounded; this matches the frozen test class.

edge_cases.stopped: waitObs0 makes B false; density and D are0 for every real time; K fiber is zero by its exact fiber identity.
edge_cases.live_infinite: waitObs infinity fails strict upper bound by finite d. timeObs0 off B receives no law mass; infinity is not normalized away.
edge_cases.d_zero: B and strict time support are empty; K/ν zero. No positive-duration premise.
edge_cases.raw_zero_negative: Clipping gives zero threshold, tau0=0 and excludes the strict-positive B event. This agrees with the declared P-null ambient extension.
edge_cases.null_A: The identity restricts to B intersect H^-1 A; no division by μ(A). Kernel bound and joint law give zero mass/integral on a null history set.
edge_cases.n_zero: H0 is the one-entry live initial history and raw w0 is unused; all functions/tests reduce to deterministic-state strict finite density.
edge_cases.rank_zero: All rates/densities zero; positive input gives infinity from initial live and stopped later, hence B and finite law zero.
edge_cases.unrealizable: Pointwise finite density and all-history K equality/mass bounds do not assume history consistency.
edge_cases.endpoint: Both event and density support use strict inequalities; exact wait=d excluded on both sides by restriction.
edge_cases.unbounded_tests: F can take infinity and d need not be bounded. Nonnegative integration handles this; the theorem does not assert finite F integrals.
edge_cases.random_stop: n fixed, d a deterministic Borel history map; no enlarged/future-informed histories or physical-time restart.
edge_cases.density_extension: The all-real unguarded density is auxiliary outside s>0. It is measurable/finite but not claimed to be a negative-time waiting density. D makes its irrelevant extension vanish in every public measure/test identity.

publication_exposition_requirements: Attribute history-dependent conditional finite density to ASTIS source-implicit completion.
Distinguish actual wait from guarded total wait/time observables; label unguarded density outside positive time as an auxiliary extension eliminated by D.
Keep all-history kernel bound distinct from any pointwise density bound and allow infinite nonnegative test integrals.
